item.title: Build a Wix Seminary Ecosystem
item.description:
250-750 USD | Wix Developer Needed, Spiritual Seminary and University Ecosystem Rebuild of ForestTherapeutics.us on Wix
Project Overview
I am seeking an experienced Wix developer and designer to rebuild my current GoDaddy website www.foresttherapeutics.us on Wix. This is not a simple business website. It is an online educational and spiritual ecosystem, a seminary and a university devoted to earth based spirituality, nature and elemental wisdom, Christ Consciousness as an inner frequency, and embodied personal transformation. The site serves as an educational institution, an online university, a digital course platform, an ecommerce store, a booking platform, a media center, and a public doorway into my wider community and coursework. The overall feel should be professional, educational, spiritual, and nature focused, welcoming and easy to navigate, fully mobile friendly, and strongly optimized for search. My current GoDaddy site has suffered persistent indexing and visibility problems, broken links, and outages, and curing that is a central reason for the move.
The Governing Principle, Build the House and I Will Arrange the Furniture
I will retain full owner control of the finished site. I manage, edit, and update it myself after launch, and I add, change, or remove features as my needs grow. For this reason the build must rest on standard, native Wix features and the Wix Editor wherever possible, rather than on locked custom code that only a developer can maintain. Think of this as building the house and setting every room in working order. I will arrange and rearrange the furniture myself. Ease of owner management after launch is a true requirement, and any custom work must be documented plainly so I can maintain it on my own.
The Platform Architecture, Three Houses That Work Together
My ecosystem lives across three connected platforms, and understanding this division is essential so that nothing is rebuilt that already lives elsewhere. Wix is the public house, holding the website, the storefront, the booking system, the public events, the media center, the blog, and the search presence, and it carries clean doorways into the other two. This is the house being built in this project. WithMe is the inner house, already built and staying in place, where my private member community, my membership tiers, my member only live classes, and my student coaching already live, so Wix links out to WithMe and does not rebuild community or memberships. SkillSpring is the classroom, holding my structured coursework, student tracking, and certificates, which I administer myself, so Wix integrates and links to SkillSpring but does not build the coursework. All paid functions run through Stripe.
Scope of Work
1. Full Website Rebuild Recreate and improve the current website on Wix, with stronger navigation, a cleaner site architecture, faster load speed, and full mobile responsiveness.
2. University and Seminary Structure Present my multiple educational divisions clearly, each with its own pages, descriptions, enrollment information, and curriculum overview. These include my digital university, my correspondence by mail school, my courses on sovereign technology and analog living, and my certification and future degree programs.
3. Ecommerce Store A robust Wix store carrying digital products such as course downloads, PDFs, e-books, and recorded workshops, membership and subscription products where they are introduced, and physical products such as ritual tools, apothecary supplies, books, and educational materials. The store runs on Stripe.
4. Dropshipping Integration My physical supplies are dropshipped through AzureGreen. The store should support physical listings, inventory, order fulfillment, and shipping calculation, and I welcome your recommendation for the cleanest Wix compatible dropshipping workflow. I will provide my product files.
5. Booking and Appointment System Using Wix Bookings, online scheduling with payment, confirmations, and reminders for my public services and classes, including in person sessions and online sessions that use the native Zoom connection.
6. Events and Ticketing Using Wix Events, the ability to create events, sell tickets, and host online events for public workshops and gatherings, with online events using the native Zoom connection.
7. Media Center A searchable, organized media area for podcast and television appearances, interviews, articles, publications, and speaking engagements.
8. Blog A robust, search friendly blog with categories across spirituality, earth based wisdom, ecology, community updates, and courses and events.
9. Video Hosting Using native Wix video, host or embed recorded teaching and marketing videos, with the ability to protect certain videos behind member access where needed.
10. File Hosting and Protected Downloads Secure hosting for PDFs, handouts, worksheets, and student materials, with some downloads restricted by access level. Preferably on Wix or my current LMS SkillSpring.
11. Email Automation Using native Wix automation, set up welcome and gift delivery sequences for new subscribers, enrollment sequences for new students, reminders for participants and appointments, and access instructions for purchases.
12. SEO Setup Complete search optimization, including Google Search Console, sitemap creation and submission, Google Business Profile integration, metadata and image optimization, mobile optimization, and indexing verification. Curing my current indexing failures is a priority outcome.
13. Domain Connection or Transfer Assistance connecting my primary domain, ForestTherapeutics.us, to the new Wix site, with guidance on whether to transfer the registration or simply point it to Wix.
14. Content Migration Guidance and help migrating my text, images, PDFs, videos, courses, blog posts, store products, and SEO assets from GoDaddy to Wix, understanding this is a rebuild rather than an automatic transfer.
What Is Out of Scope To keep the project lean and clear, the following are not part of this build and are only integrated or linked. The member community and the membership tiers, which live on WithMe. The structured coursework and certificates, which live in SkillSpring. And PayPal, which is not used anywhere.
Phased Delivery I would welcome the build delivered in sensible phases, so that a clean and beautiful landing and enrollment doorway can open first while the deeper architecture rises behind it, followed by the store and membership links, the SkillSpring integration and gated areas, the bookings and events, and finally the automations, the full SEO setup, and the content migration. I welcome your proposed phase plan and an honest timeline for each stage.
What I Will Provide I will provide all of my written content, my images and logos, my brand colors and aesthetic direction, my product files, and the access the work requires. My aesthetic is earthy, natural, elegant, grounded, and gently mystical, drawing on warm earth tones, goldenrod and forest greens, and vintage woodcut and old world apothecary accents, with a timeless, literary feeling.
Who I Am Looking For I am looking for a developer who has built complex Wix ecosystems before, not only simple business sites, and who is comfortable with Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, Wix Events, Wix automations, SEO setup, and integrations with outside platforms such as SkillSpring or other LMS and Stripe. Clear communication, honest timelines, and a willingness to leave me in full control of my own site afterward matter as much to me as technical skill.
This is not a simple business website. It is an online educational and spiritual ecosystem consisting of a seminary, a digital university, a membership community, an ecommerce store, a media center, and a student platform. Experience building complex Wix ecosystems is strongly preferred.
How to Apply
In your proposal, please tell me briefly about Wix ecosystems you have built, confirm your experience with Wix Stores, Bookings, Events, and outside integrations such as SkillSpring, Moodle and Stripe, share your proposed phase plan and a realistic timeline, and outline how you structure milestones and payment.
I look forward to building something beautiful and lasting together.

Experience with SaaS platforms, subscription systems, marketplaces or multi-user applications would be an advantage.

Milestone 2 – Development
* Implement the agreed frontend and backend functionality. * Provide progress updates and a reviewable development version.

* Test functionality and responsiveness. * Resolve agreed issues and outstanding bugs.
Milestone 4 – Final Delivery
* Supply completed source code. * Provide documentation and deployment instructions. * Complete final handover.
Milestone values and deadlines will be agreed before work begins.
When Applying

1. A short introduction and overview of your development experience. 2. Links to at least two previous projects. 3. Your experience with React, Next.js and backend development. 4. Your preferred development stack for this project. 5. Your estimated availability. 6. Your proposed fixed-price quotation or hourly rate. 7. An indication of whether you would be interested in further development engagements.
About the Business
We are developing a portfolio of digital products and services under Blackwellen Ltd.
Our development work is focused on modern web applications, SaaS products and digital platforms.
We value quality, clear communication and long-term professional relationships with reliable independent developers.
Platform & Project Management

The goal is for better control and management of the products and orders placed on the site to flow automatically to the external system, pull back tracking numbers, stock levels, and status updates, and reflect those changes inside WooCommerce without manual intervention.
Current setup: • WordPress + WooCommerce running on the latest stable versions • A child theme with light customisation (no edits to core files) • Existing connections all done with Wordpress API to AWS EC2
What I expect from you: • A clean, self-contained plugin or an extension of an existing one that handles the API handshake, authentication, and data sync • Use of WordPress standards—actions, filters, nonces, proper enqueuing—so future updates do not break anything • Configuration screen inside the WooCommerce settings tab where I can paste API keys, pick update intervals, and toggle features • Error logging and basic debug mode to help trace issues in production • Brief documentation outlining installation, settings, and any cron or web-hook URLs required
Acceptance criteria: 1. New orders created in WooCommerce instantly appear in the external system through a webhook / push. 2. WooCommerce products not aligned or deleted are notified to the source system. 3. Stock adjustments sent from the external system respect existing back-order rules.
Please confirm familiarity with WooCommerce REST API, PHP 8, and other plugins. If you have questions about the target platform, let me know .

item.title: Full-Service Amazon Store Management

Requirements: - Store setup and product listing: We need an appealing and optimized store, with all products listed professionally from the get-go. - Product sourcing: We expect high-quality, trendy clothing that's competitively priced. - Inventory management: Efficient tracking and management of stock levels. - Customer service and returns: Excellent customer service to handle inquiries and returns promptly and professionally.
